text:
talia: Quick thread 1 marketplace 'nudge' idea: when a customer accepts a private offer, surface an option to convert X% into a reserved credit and enroll in auto-renew to unlock the rest. Low-friction upsell and helps with renewals. Thoughts?
omar: Love it. We should be careful w/ expiration windows. Suggest default 60d to redeem, unlocked amounts vest on first renewal.
yvonne: finance: need conversion parity details. propose two presets: conservative (convert 85% upfront, 10% on renewal, 5% on 12mo commit) and aggressive (95% upfront, 5% on renewal). Will prep simple P&L deltas.
mike: SEs: field-friendly UX is key. Make it one-click in Console with a short explainer. Also add a small banner in the partner portal so SI knows the customer's enrolled.
legal-bot: legal-bot: flagged AWS & Azure private-offer clauses for review. Will return redlines by EOD.
talia: Ops question: do we issue Redwood voucher IDs that map to reserved SKUs? Need audit trail + partner webhook.
omar: yes. Flow: verify private-offer spend via marketplace API -> mint Redwood voucher -> apply to account as pending reserved credit -> emit webhook on unlock. Idempotent flow required.
yvonne: acctg-bot: created ticket ACCT-2210 to model rev-rec impact and clawback language.
mike: Field asks: restrict to net-new customers or allow renewals? My vote: net-new only for pilot.
talia: Agreed pilot: net-new only, two SI partners, target 10 customers. Timeline: 5 weeks to prototype + one-week canary.
omar: Technical: watch marketplace API rate limits + mapping table for SKUs. I'll add a sample CSV mapping in INF-4999.
legal-bot: Quick note: include explicit "no double-dip" clause and expiry for marketplace credits.
yvonne: Finance to share conversion model by Wed. I'll include churn sensitivity.
talia: OK next steps: Omar infra ticket, Yvonne finance model, Legal redline, Mike to draft Console checkbox copy. Brief GTM after canary.
mike: I'll draft copy and quick FAQ for sellers.
note: Slack-style coordination thread about a marketplace private-offer -> reserved credit "nudge" program. Messages are short, chronological, prefixed by sender names.
